dz: 阿拉伯-拜占庭战争:拜占庭帝国与拉希通哈里发之间的耶尔穆克战役开始.
de: Arab–Byzantine wars: The Battle of Yarmouk between the Byzantine Empire and the Rashidun Caliphate begins.

dz: 雅尔穆克之战:标志着穆斯林征服的第一波伟大浪潮和伊斯兰在阿拉伯外的迅速发展,由哈立德·伊本·瓦利德所领导的阿拉伯军队击败了拜占庭帝国并控制了黎凡特.
de: Battle of the Yarmuk: Marking the first great wave of Muslim conquests and the rapid advance of Islam outside Arabia, Arab forces led by Khalid ibn al-Walid defeat the Byzantine Empire and take control of the Levant.

t: 拉希通·哈里发在伊拉克的al-Qādisiyyah战役中击败了萨珊帝国.
te: The Rashidun Caliphate defeats the Sasanian Empire at the Battle of al-Qādisiyyah in Iraq.
dz: 拉希通·哈里发在伊拉克的al-Qādisiyyah战役中击败了萨珊帝国.
